$Comment: Jack Skeletons and Hollow Ghouls after dark while Hallow's Eve runs. When the event starts, the
calendar writes Spawn as the game's own world-spawn rule Hallows_Eve_Night; when it ends, the
calendar rewrites that rule with every moon phase at zero, so nothing new spawns. A rule is never
removed. Harvest_Moon_Night_Spawns.json names the same Rule at a higher Priority, so on Harvest
Moon nights its body (the same creatures, higher weights) takes over and hands the rule back after.
Spawn is read by the game's NPC/Spawn/World codec, so it takes every key a vanilla rule takes:
DayTimeRange 19 to 5 is the night, Despawn clears what is still out at dawn, and LightRanges keeps
them away from anywhere a torch or a lantern lights. A stilled rule keeps its Despawn, so what is
out when the event ends is gone by the next dawn. The game allows one rule per creature and
environment, so no other rule in this pack names these two roles.
To make the night busier or quieter, change the Weight values here and in the Harvest Moon file
together, keeping Harvest Moon's the higher pair.
